sentences.text: When a cloud service reuses an IP address to create a new compute instance, you may experience a host validation error if you had SSH to the IP address before.

sourceRef.title: Manage Your Own VPN - A Penny-Pincher's Guide

sentences.text: This occurs because the new compute instance generates a new host key, which does not match the key you trusted in .ssh/known_hosts .

sourceRef.title: Manage Your Own VPN - A Penny-Pincher's Guide

sentences.text: To resolve this issue, you can either remove the trusted host key using ssh-keygen -R or send the private key from your local machine to the new compute instance.

sentences.text: However, Alibaba Cloud requires account verification after a few uses of IP addresses and resources from a country other than China, which asks me to upload my passport, etc.
